ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 15% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark background across both lobes. High-intensity features are mapped as discrete, sparse linear streaks and small circular points scattered across the entire surface; no large contiguous geometric white areas are detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 100 degrees; depth is clearly defined against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits fine-scale, high-frequency serrations. A significant irregular indentation/discontinuity is visible on the medial portion of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges show a concave curve originating from the median notch, flattening toward the mid-lobe before meeting the heavily textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual circular white spots are visible throughout the central dark regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-intensity linear marks of varying lengths (10-100+ pixels) distributed across the entire ventral surface, cutting across the primary dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe. Heavy protruding textured masses (consistent with barnacle colonization) at both lateral tips.
